style.base: Painted dark-fantasy game art, rich colours, soft rim light, clean composition, no text, no letters, no watermark
style.item: a single object centred on a plain dark background, three-quarter view, like an inventory icon
style.token: head-and-shoulders portrait inside a circular frame, facing the viewer, like a tabletop token
style.map: seamless tileable ground texture seen from directly above, even flat lighting, no objects, no furniture, no people, no shadows of objects, no grid lines, no border
style.sprite: a single object seen from directly above (top-down), for a tabletop battle map, centred and filling most of the frame, on a flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, no shadow on the background, no magenta on the object
